coverage: AttemptLifecycleServiceTest + 5 sibling files (submitAnswer/playAudio/submitAttempt/heartbeat/encrypted-submission): ported from services/exam-delivery's 6 AttemptService test files — full state-machine coverage (startAttempt encryptionPublicKey gating, blank-payload acceptance, pessimistic-lock choke point on every currentOrderIndex/playCount mutator, plain-vs-encrypted routing enforcement).

SnapshotPinServiceTest: ported, with SchedulingClient/AuthoringClient/MediaClient replaced by SessionService/AssessmentService/MediaService mocks; dynamic prep-timing, audio/image presign branches, and a new test asserting a presign failure propagates media's own exception unmodified (no more 503-shaped AudioResolutionFailedException wrapper).
AttemptMapperTest, TimerServiceTest, HeartbeatServiceTest, SubmissionDecryptionServiceTest, TaskTimingConfigTest, EncryptionKeyProviderTest: ported unchanged (pure logic, no HTTP client dependency).

ProctorCommandServiceTest (new): forceSubmit in-progress/already-submitted/unknown-attempt paths — no direct source test existed (only exercised indirectly via the RabbitMQ consumer this port doesn't carry).
deviations: No outbox/event publishing anywhere in this phase — AnswerSubmitService/ProctorCommandService/AttemptLifecycleService.completeAttempt persist state only; AnswerSubmitted/AttemptSubmitted events deferred to Phase 08-10 when scoring/reporting/notification exist to receive them.

Dropped as unreachable in-process: EntitlementCheckFailedException, SnapshotContentFetchFailedException, AudioResolutionFailedException, ImageResolutionFailedException (503-shaped defensive wrappers around a null HTTP response — impossible once the call is a Java method that either returns data or throws). Also dropped: AttemptNotInProgressException (dead code, never thrown in source) and attempt's own NotEntitledException (session's own propagates unmodified instead).

MockExamController (source: @Profile("mock-exam-delivery") dev-only in-memory stub predating the real backend) not ported — its reason to exist is gone now that itembank/assessment/session/media are real and working in the monolith.

InternalExportController + AnswerExportItem/AttemptExportItem (keyset-paginated export feeding a reporting read-model rebuild) not ported, along with the matching findSubmittedForExport repository queries — Phase 10 will query attempt's own tables directly, per the plan's no-projection mandate.

com.pte.media.dto.response required a @NamedInterface package-info.java (same pattern as itembank/assessment/session) — attempt is the first module to consume MediaService's response type cross-module.
